template.name: pymcu-blink-mp
template.value:
from machine import Pin from time import sleep_ms
led = Pin($PIN$, Pin.OUT)
while True: led.value(1) sleep_ms($MS$) led.value(0) sleep_ms($MS$) $END$
template.description: LED blink using the MicroPython compat layer

template.name: pymcu-blink-cp
template.value:
import board import digitalio import time
led = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.$PIN$) led.direction = digitalio.Direction.OUTPUT
while True: led.value = True time.sleep($SECONDS$) led.value = False time.sleep($SECONDS$) $END$
template.description: LED blink using the CircuitPython compat layer

template.name: pymcu-blink-avr
template.value:
from pymcu.chips.$CHIP$ import DDRB, PORTB, DDB5, PORTB5 from pymcu.time import delay_ms
def main(): DDRB[DDB5] = 1 while True: PORTB[PORTB5] = 1 delay_ms($MS$) PORTB[PORTB5] = 0 delay_ms($MS$) $END$
template.description: LED blink writing AVR registers directly
